newsitem.title: USA: Mich. House approves $69 mln road funds for FY '97.
newsitem.headline: Mich. House approves $69 mln road funds for FY '97.

text.p: Michigan representatives have approved a $69 million appropriation from the state's "rainy day" fund for road repairs during the current fiscal year, a House analyst said Friday.

The House on Thursday approved the one-time appropriation from the state's budget stabilization fund limited strictly to financing resurfacing and repair projects, fiscal analyst Robert Schneider said.
Michigan senators earlier approved the appropriation, but slight amendments to the bill by representatives will require another vote of the Senate, Schneider said.
If approved, it would be a first for lawmakers to dip into the fund for transportation needs, although they have done so for other areas, Schneider said.

If projections hold true, Michigan will have $1.2 billion to $1.3 billion in its rainy day fund at the end of fiscal 1998, Schneider noted. The transportation appropriation would take interest, but not principal, from the fund, he said.
